integrity: The code gives a fully enumerated exact finite calculation. No independent mathematical audit has been performed; publication priority and unindexed equivalent tables remain open to human assessment.
scientific_limitations: The calculation is for complex full-flag Schubert varieties in type F4, not parabolic Schubert varieties or local class groups. For the 919 non-Q-factorial members only positive free rank is asserted, not the full torsion. The underlying divisor-basis criterion is prior work.
title: Integral Weil–Cartier strata of type-\(F_4\) full-flag Schubert varieties
